title: The Bible
text: The Bible contains the inspired and infallible Word of God.

title: One God — Trinity
text: One God eternally existent in three Persons: Father, Son and Holy Ghost.

title: Deity of Christ
text: Jesus was born of a virgin, conceived of the Holy Ghost, died, rose bodily, ascended bodily.

title: Rapture & Second Coming
text: We believe in the rapture of the Church and the Second Coming of Christ.

title: Cleansing from Sin
text: Only through repentance and faith in the precious blood of Jesus.

title: Regeneration
text: By the power of the Holy Spirit through the Word — essential for salvation.

title: Divine Healing
text: The redemptive work on the cross provides healing for the body and salvation for the soul.

title: Holy Ghost Enablement
text: Receiving the Holy Ghost gives power for Christian service and witness.

title: Sanctifying Power
text: We believe in the sanctifying power of the Holy Ghost.

title: Final Resurrection
text: Resurrection of saved to eternal life and lost to eternal judgement.

title: Prosperity & Success
text: We believe divine life includes righteousness, health, prosperity and victory through the Word.
